# SolarMOT

> Subscription solar panel maintenance for homes and businesses in Dorset, England.
> Cleaning, a documented safety and performance inspection, and minor repairs —
> scheduled automatically and paid monthly by Direct Debit.

SolarMOT maintains solar photovoltaic systems that other companies installed. It is
not an MCS-certified installer and does not sell or fit solar panels. "MOT" is used
descriptively, by analogy with a vehicle MOT; it is not a statutory test.

## Services

- Solar panel cleaning (1 or 2 scheduled visits a year depending on plan)
- Documented inspection: mounting and fixings, cabling and connectors, isolators,
  seals and weatherproofing, inverter and error codes, output reading
- Written report after every visit
- Minor repairs (fixings, seals, connectors) included on Standard and Premium
- Initial baseline survey for every new customer, since systems were installed by others

## Plans (residential, GBP, billed monthly by Direct Debit)

- Essential — 19.99/month, 1 visit a year, no minimum term, plus a 149 one-off initial survey
- Standard — 29.99/month, 2 visits a year, minor repairs included, plus a 75 one-off initial survey
- Premium — 39.99/month, 2 visits a year, 2 priority callouts, 48-hour response,
  output monitoring, 20% off larger repairs, initial survey included free

Commercial: 4–15 GBP per kWp per year, minimum contract 750 GBP/year.
Systems under roughly 20 kWp are usually better served by a residential plan.

## Coverage

Currently Dorset (DT and BH postcodes): Bournemouth, Poole, Christchurch, Dorchester,
Weymouth, Wimborne, Ringwood, Blandford Forum, Sherborne, Bridport, Swanage, Wareham.
Year 2: Hampshire, Somerset, Devon and the wider South Coast. Year 3+: England-wide.
